description: Journald logs from hosts and nspawn service containers, collected by Alloy and stored in Loki. Fields that Alloy attaches as structured metadata (Caddy access logs) are always filterable; switch Parser to JSON or logfmt to parse other services' lines at query time.

spec.expr: sum by (container) (count_over_time({source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority"} |~ "$search" | $parser [$__range]))

sum by (container) (count_over_time({source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority", priority="warning"} |~ "$search" | $parser [$__range]))

sum by (container) (count_over_time({source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority", priority=~"err|crit|alert|emerg"} |~ "$search" | $parser [$__range]))
sum by (container) (bytes_over_time({source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority"} |~ "$search" | $parser [$__range]))

spec.description: Per-container log counts for the selected time range. Click a column header to sort.
spec.title: Containers

spec.expr: sum by (container, unit) (count_over_time({source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority"} |~ "$search" | $parser [$__range]))

sum by (container, unit) (count_over_time({source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority", priority="warning"} |~ "$search" | $parser [$__range]))

sum by (container, unit) (count_over_time({source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority", priority=~"err|crit|alert|emerg"} |~ "$search" | $parser [$__range]))
sum by (container, unit) (bytes_over_time({source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority"} |~ "$search" | $parser [$__range]))

spec.description: Per-unit log counts for the selected time range. Click a column header to sort.
spec.title: Units

spec.expr: sum by (container, unit) (count_over_time({source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority", priority="warning"} |~ "$search" | $parser [$__auto]))

spec.description: Warning-priority lines per interval, stacked by unit.
spec.title: Warnings by unit

spec.expr: sum by (container, unit) (count_over_time({source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority", priority=~"err|crit|alert|emerg"} |~ "$search" | $parser [$__auto]))

spec.description: Error-and-above lines per interval, stacked by unit.
spec.title: Errors by unit

spec.expr: {source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority", priority=~"warning|err|crit|alert|emerg"} |~ "$search" | $parser

spec.description: Application lines at warning priority or higher. Expand a line and use the filter buttons on a field to add it to the field filters above.
spec.title: Warnings and errors

spec.expr: {source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority"} |~ "(?i)(failed|failure|error|exception|panic|fatal|permission denied|start-limit-hit|oom|out of memory|context canceled)" |~ "$search" | $parser

spec.description: Any-priority lines whose message mentions a failure, error, panic or OOM.
spec.title: Failure signals

spec.expr: {source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority"} |~ "$search" | $parser

spec.description: All application lines matching the filters. JSON lines are parsed: use the field selector on the left to show only the fields you want, and the filter buttons in log details to filter on a field value.
spec.title: Application logs

spec.expr: {source="journald", container=~"$container"} |~ "(?i)(^(Starting|Finished|Reached target|Listening on|Mounted|Mounting|Unmounted|Unmounting|Startup finished|Stopping|Stopped|Created slice|Removed slice)|systemd|tmpfiles|journal|utmp|mount|unmount|veth|networkd|nspawn|machine|boot|shutdown|reboot|ConditionNeedsUpdate|unmet condition check|Failed to increase receive buffer size|Setting access ACL|fchownat[(][)]|Failed to reopen|Failed unmounting)" |~ "$search"

spec.description: Container and host boot/system plumbing lines, kept out of the application views.
spec.title: Boot and system logs

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority"} |~ "$search" | $parser [$__range]))

spec.description: Application log lines in the selected time range.
spec.title: Log lines

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority", priority="warning"} |~ "$search" | $parser [$__range]))

spec.description: Lines at warning priority in the selected time range.
spec.title: Warnings

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority", priority=~"err|crit|alert|emerg"} |~ "$search" | $parser [$__range]))

spec.description: Lines at err, crit, alert or emerg priority in the selected time range.
spec.title: Errors

spec.expr: count(sum by (container) (count_over_time({source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority"} |~ "$search" | $parser [$__range])))

spec.description: Hosts and service containers that produced application logs.
spec.title: Containers logging

spec.expr: count(sum by (container, unit) (count_over_time({source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority"} |~ "$search" | $parser [$__range])))

spec.description: Systemd units that produced application logs.
spec.title: Units logging

spec.expr: sum(bytes_over_time({source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority"} |~ "$search" | $parser [$__range]))

spec.description: Bytes of application log lines in the selected time range.
spec.title: Log volume

spec.expr: sum by (priority) (count_over_time({source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority"} |~ "$search" | $parser [$__auto]))

spec.description: Application log lines per interval, stacked by journald priority.
spec.title: Log lines by priority

spec.expr: topk(15, sum by (container) (count_over_time({source="journald", container=~"$container", unit=~"$unit", unit=~".+[.]service", unit!~"$noise", priority=~"$priority"} |~ "$search" | $parser [$__auto])))

spec.description: Application log lines per interval for the busiest containers.
spec.title: Log lines by container
